user.title: CARnet - Garage Log
user.description: Free Gemini API key (optional) for automatic generation of the maintenance plan, known issues and resale value estimate. Also choose the content language for the whole integration (card, catalog, AI-generated text, notifications) — this can be changed later from the integration's Options.

abort.already_configured: CARnet - Garage Log is already set up. This integration only supports a single entry (all vehicles, caches and settings share one storage file) — use Settings → Devices & services → CARnet - Garage Log → Configure to change the API key or language instead of adding a new entry.
